title: Native K-flat replacement and quasi-isomorphism calculus
statement: Every cochain complex of Pro-étale Weil sheaves admits a quasi-isomorphism from a complex satisfying the native tensor K-flat predicate, and the quasi-isomorphisms on these complexes have a right calculus of fractions.

source.place: Native tensor model, localization field; Stacks 06YS and the derived-category fraction calculus.

proof.text: Construct the unbounded K-flat replacement by the telescope of bounded truncation replacements. Closure of the native acyclic-test predicate under the required sums and cones makes the telescope native K-flat, and its augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism.
Transport the Ore and cancellation witnesses for quasi-isomorphisms from the homotopy quotient to complexes, using the quotient characterization of quasi-isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Native K-flat replacement and fraction calculus needed by the localization field.

mathlib_searches.query: every unbounded cochain complex admits a native acyclic-test K-flat quasi-isomorphic replacement
mathlib_searches.results: No exact NativeTensorKFlat theorem; generic K-flat resolution APIs require additional ringed hypotheses and do not identify the native predicate.
The homotopy-category quasi-isomorphism calculus is available, but no direct complex-level theorem transports it to this native setting.

from.place: Replacement and fraction-calculus input for the native K-flat localization field.

lean.statement: theorem native_weil_tensor_ringed_kflat_resolution : let W₀ := HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) (.up ℤ) W₀.HasRightCalculusOfFractions ∧ let P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ) := NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X T ∀ K : CochainComplex (ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) ℤ, ∃ (P' : P.FullSubcategory) (s : P.ι.obj P' ⟶ K), W₀ s
